items.question: Which additional plants and what quantity are prescribed as worship materials?
premises: siṃhī is specified as a worship herb
a pair of dundūka is prescribed
a handful of apāmārga is included together
items.inference: these plants and measure form part of the prescribed herbal offerings for worship
uncertainties: exact botanical identification of siṃhī and dundūka
items.plain_english: Siṃhī, a pair of dundūka, and a handful of apāmārga together.
